patches.name: Own premium plan
patches.description: Reports the account as an active premium subscription with a fully featured, zero-cost premium plan in every plan catalog, so no premium upsell/trial UI appears.

patches.name: Selectable install backend
patches.description: Adds a setting to choose how F-Droid installs APKs: system default, Shizuku, InstallerX, or a custom installer package.
